sloka: आर्येण किम् नु कैकेय्याः कृतम् रामेण विप्रियम् ।यन्मया चीर वसनस् तया प्रस्थापितो वनम् ।। ६-३२-५।।
transliteration: āryeṇa kim nu kaikeyyāḥ kṛtam rāmeṇa vipriyam ।yanmayā cīra vasanas tayā prasthāpito vanam ।। 6-32-5।।

translations.english: "Kaikeyi, you have given bark robes to prince Rama and sent him to the forest with me. What harm has he done for you? Thinking of this again and again Sita cried."
